summary: Backend testing completed for new dissídio features: PDF Export and Piso Salarial Validation. All 17 tests passed (1 skipped due to no test data without convention data). Fixed a bug in error handling for calcular-retroativo endpoint.

minor.issue: HTTPException was being caught by generic Exception handler and re-raised as 500 error
minor.fix_applied: Added explicit HTTPException catch before generic Exception to preserve original status codes (404, 400)

passed_tests: GET /api/calculos-dissidio/{id}/exportar-convencao-pdf - exports valid PDF with correct content-type
POST /api/dissidio/calcular-retroativo - returns 400 when percentual_reajuste is missing
POST /api/dissidio/calcular-retroativo - creates calculation with alertas_piso field in response
Response structure includes alertas_piso as list
Integration test: create cliente, colaborador, and calculation flow works
critical_code_review_comments: PDF export endpoint correctly uses reportlab library with Business Contabilidade branding
Piso salarial validation logic at lines 3781-3822 correctly checks both function-specific and general piso
alertas_piso field is properly included in both the calculation response and stored document
Error handling was improved - HTTPException now properly propagates instead of being wrapped in 500
seed_data_creation: Test creates temporary cliente and colaborador, then cleans up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: New dissídio features tested: 1) GET /api/calculos-dissidio/{id}/exportar-convencao-pdf - exports PDF from existing calculation with convention data. Returns 400 if calculation has no dados_convencao. 2) POST /api/dissidio/calcular-retroativo - includes alertas_piso in response when employees are below piso salarial. The piso validation checks both function-specific pisos (pisos_por_funcao) and general piso (piso_salarial). Fixed bug where HTTPException was being caught and re-raised as 500.

pdf_export_from_calculo.description: Exports PDF with convention summary from existing calculation. Uses reportlab with Business Contabilidade branding.
pdf_export_from_calculo.requirements: Calculation must have dados_convencao field populated

alertas_piso_validation.description: Validates employee salaries against piso salarial during retroactive calculation. Returns alertas_piso array with details when employees are below piso.
alertas_piso_validation.validation_logic: 1) Checks function-specific piso (pisos_por_funcao), 2) Falls back to general piso (piso_salarial), 3) Compares new calculated salary against applicable piso

bug_fixed.issue: HTTPException (404, 400) was being caught by generic Exception handler and re-raised as 500 Internal Server Error
bug_fixed.fix: Added explicit 'except HTTPException: raise' before generic Exception catch
bug_fixed.impact: Proper error codes now returned to client (404 for not found, 400 for bad request)
